name: Immigration court backlog, representation and asylum outcomes (EOIR workload statistics and case data)
description: The size and movement of the U.S. immigration court backlog, from the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR). National series from EOIR's workload and adjudication statistics: pending cases, new cases, completions, the share of completed cases with a representative on record, asylum decisions and the share of grants among grants and denials, asylum applications pending and pending cases of unaccompanied children, by fiscal year. Pending proceedings by immigration court, by the respondent's state of address and by nationality, counted from EOIR's monthly FOIA case-data file, with the share that has a representative of record. Counts only: no case row, name or address is published, and every count published is 11 or more. Every national table is re-added against its own totals row; the case-data counts are shown beside the published totals and never spliced into them.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Immigration court backlog, representation and asylum outcomes (EOIR workload statistics and case data) (Version 2.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24183839

distribution.name: immigration-courts.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: immigration-courts.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: immigration-courts-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in immigration-courts-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to immigration-courts.csv on id.

recordSet.name: immigration-courts
recordSet.description: The records of Immigration court backlog, representation and asylum outcomes (EOIR workload statistics and case data), one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: US for national series, or the two-letter code of the state: the respondent's state of address for state records, and the state where the court sits for court records

field.name: measure
field.description: What is counted, in plain words

field.name: period
field.description: The fiscal year (2025), the fiscal year to a quarter end (2026Q3, the fiscal year runs October 1 to September 30) or the date of the case-data file (2026-10-01)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: The count, or a percent for the representation rate and the grant share (see unit)

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
